clips.title: The story
paras: The Wooden Key is a simple carved key carried by the maddened ancients roaming northern Ashenvale near the border of Felwood. It unlocks a concealed chest holding a remnant of Dartol's Rod, an ancient night elven relic.

The Wooden Key is held by the Crazed and Withered Ancients wandering the shaded trails north of Raynewood Retreat. Shael'dryn once knew the local treants, but now describes their nature as twisted by corruption. One of them carries the key to a chest holding a piece of Dartol's Rod.
